name: Buildkite API
tagline: REST API for pipelines, builds, agents, and CI analytics
description: Buildkite provides a REST API for managing CI/CD resources: organizations, pipelines, builds, jobs, agents, teams, and test analytics. Pipeline-as-code workflows run on customer-hosted or Buildkite-managed agent fleets. Developers authenticate with personal API access tokens and call https://api.buildkite.com/v2.

auth.details: Personal API access token via Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_TOKEN (or Token). Create tokens in user settings; scope permissions per token. GraphQL also supported.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free plan available for small teams; API access included. Exact request quotas not published on pricing page — limits are plan/usage based rather than a fixed free API request count.
pricing.paid_plans: Paid plans (e.g. Business/Enterprise) scale by concurrent jobs/agents and seats; see buildkite.com/pricing. API itself is not separately metered by public fixed free request counts.

rate_limits: Published: REST API is rate-limited. Responses include RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining, RateLimit-Reset headers. Default documented limit is typically 100 requests per minute per token (confirm in current docs); 429 on exceed. Exact numbers can vary — check response headers.
use_cases: list pipelines in a Buildkite organization
trigger a new build on a pipeline with branch and commit
get build status and job logs for a specific build
list and inspect connected CI agents and their metadata
cancel or rebuild a failed build via API
fetch test analytics or annotations for a build
